mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.real_name, u.avatar, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.remark, u.current_city, u.current_status, u.target_direction, u.target_city, coalesce((select v.vef_status from t_usr_verify v where v.vef_user_id = u.user_id order by v.vef_id desc limit 1), 0) as verify_status, (select count(*) from t_app_record a inner join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id where t.tal_user_id = u.user_id) as application_count, (select count(*) from t_sch_appointment a inner join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id where t.tal_user_id = u.user_id and a.apt_status in (0, 1)) as interview_count, (select count(*) from t_usr_interest i where i.int_user_id = u.user_id and i.int_status = 1) as favorite_count, coalesce((select timestampdiff(year, min(w.wrk_start_date), curdate()) from t_res_work w inner join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = w.wrk_resume_id where r.rbs_user_id = u.user_id and r.rbs_status = 1 and w.wrk_start_date is not null), 0) as work_years from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update sys_user set nick_name = #{nickName}, real_name = #{realName}, email = #{email}, phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, sex = #{sex}, remark = #{remark}, current_city = #{currentCity}, current_status = #{currentStatus}, target_direction = #{targetDirection}, target_city = #{targetCity}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
